title: spec.skill.md Phase 5 patch_file multi-line anchor fails on Windows CRLF README table rows
description: Phase 5 README row insertion required two failed patch_file attempts before succeeding. Both failures used multi-line old_string patterns spanning a table row plus the adjacent '### vcs' section header; both returned 'old_string not found'. The third attempt used only the single last table row as anchor and succeeded. This re-opens the existing pattern tracked in e6a12400. The root cause is likely line-ending or encoding differences around section boundaries in the CRLF README on Windows.
proposed_resolution: Update spec.skill.md Phase 5 to instruct agents to use a single-line old_string anchor (the last table row only, excluding adjacent section headers). Alternatively, direct agents to prefer write_file with full README content after a patch_file failure rather than retrying with multi-line patterns.
